Name: Beach Pets (Content Patcher)
Author: andril11
Description:
[center][size=6]-------------------------------------------------------[/size]

[img]https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/575416522823172117/796034784618872892/description.png[/img]﻿

[size=5]This mod replaces the pets from the game with some beach-themed animals for you!
(for now, we only have a crab)
With completely new sprites and sound replacement!

[img]https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/575416522823172117/796047236722982922/included-pets.png[/img]﻿﻿
[i][Spoiler] [/i]

Mr. Crabs!
[i][Spoiler] [/i]
[img]https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/575416522823172117/796047874919890954/Crab_Pet.png[/img]﻿
﻿[i][i][/spoiler][/i][/i]

And more to come!
[i]
[/spoiler][/i]
[size=6]-------------------------------------------------------[/size]

[/size][img]https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/575416522823172117/796035619738484817/requirements.png[/img]﻿

[size=5]This mod requires the following frameworks:[list]
[*][size=5][url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url]﻿[/size]
[*][size=5][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4]Content Patcher[/url]﻿[/size]
[*][size=5][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3043]Custom Music[/url]﻿[/size]
[/list]
Is not required, but recommended:

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4232]Pet Interaction[/url]﻿

[size=6]-------------------------------------------------------[/size]

[img]https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/575416522823172117/796036752694444083/compatibility.png[/img]﻿

This mod is compatible with the 1.5 updates and with the 1.4 updates on android.
It shouldn't conflict with any other mod unless it replaces the animals. (for now just the first cat)

[size=6]-------------------------------------------------------[/size]

[img]https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/575416522823172117/796037225183445062/cradits.png[/img]﻿
